recognize_zh: 血小板凝集儀報表：ristocetin 1.2 mg/mL 凝集最大達 104%，其餘促效劑（ADP、epinephrine、arachidonic acid）幾乎無凝集、collagen 反應明顯低下；只保留 ristocetin 反應的模式代表 GPIIb/IIIa（αIIbβ3）缺陷，即 Glanzmann 血小板無力症。
features: Ristocetin 1.2 mg/mL tracing (channel 1): full aggregation, maximal amplitude 104%, AUC 522
ADP 10%, epinephrine 1%, arachidonic acid 0%: flat tracings with small shape-change spikes only
Collagen: delayed, partial response with maximal amplitude about 30%
describe_en: This figure is a light transmission aggregometry report displaying six agonist tracings and a numeric summary. Only high-dose ristocetin (1.2 mg/mL) induces full platelet agglutination (maximal aggregation 104%), with no response to low-dose ristocetin. Aggregation to ADP (10%), epinephrine (1%), and arachidonic acid (0%) is essentially absent, and collagen elicits a slow, markedly reduced response (about 30%). This isolated preservation of ristocetin-induced agglutination with failure of agonist-induced aggregation is characteristic of an αIIbβ3 (GPIIb/IIIa) defect, and with normal platelet count and VWF studies, findings are consistent with Glanzmann thrombasthenia; flow cytometry for CD41/CD61 can confirm.

ddx.vs: Ristocetin response is absent while other agonists aggregate normally, with macrothrombocytopenia.

ddx.dx: Type 2B or platelet-type von Willebrand disease
ddx.vs: Shows enhanced aggregation at low-dose ristocetin (0.6 mg/mL), which is absent here.

ddx.dx: Acquired anti-αIIbβ3 effect (GPIIb/IIIa inhibitor drugs or autoantibody)
ddx.vs: Produces an identical aggregometry pattern; distinguished by drug history or acquired onset rather than a lifelong bleeding history.
